variety_description: A long duration variety suitable for deep water ecology in wet season. Released by NRRI, Cuttack in 2011 for growing in irrigated lowland areas of Odisha and UP. Medium slender grain with average yield potential under normal conditions.  Tolerant to leaf blast, sheath rot, brown spot, thrips and leaf folder. Non-lodging and non-shattering.
